newsitem.title: NORWAY: First appraisal well spudded on Azeri Chirag field.
newsitem.headline: First appraisal well spudded on Azeri Chirag field.

text.p: Partners in the Azeri Chirag oilfield in the Caspian Sea have completed the first of three appraisal wells, Den norske stats oljeselskap said on Thursday.

"The reservoirs came in as expected and testing has so far yielded positive results with a maximum flow rate of roughly 6,000 barrels per day," Sigmund Helland, project manager for the Chirag field in the British Petroleum /Statoil alliance, told the company's Status Weekly newsletter.
Spudded on September 17 from the semi-submersible Dada Gorgud, the well was drilled to a depth of 2,958 metres below sea level.
The Chirag field could contain four billion barrels of oil. It is operated by Azerbaijan International Operating Company.
Production is due to start in late 1997.
